goal: Save a cat from a tall tree

interactions.description: Preconditions: bucket empty, rocks available, hammer at hand. Action: fill the bucket with rocks and place it beneath the tree; use the hammer to drive a screw-eye or small stake into the trunk and attach a short harness/line from the screw-eye to the bucket so the bucket acts as a counterweight anchor and visible/cushioned landing zone.

Preconditions: screw-eye installed and bucket anchored beneath tree. Action: use the hammer to fasten or lash the umbrella (handle or ribs) to the screw-eye/harness so the umbrella can be positioned as a wide, soft catch-net over the bucket.

Preconditions: umbrella positioned over anchor as catch-net (can be momentarily manipulated). Action: close or partially collapse the umbrella to use its handle as a gentle hook/extended reach while someone offers strong-smelling treats carried in the coffee cup to lure and coax the cat toward a lower branch or the harness area.

Preconditions: cat guided closer and harness/fasteners will be handled. Action: use the alcohol spray to disinfect the improvised harness/fasteners that contact the cat (and wipe the coffee cup if it was handled) to reduce infection risk before any close contact or manual retrieval.
interactions.effect: harness/fasteners: un_disinfected -> disinfected_with_alcohol_spray; coffee cup: used_to_lure -> wiped_or_cleaned

interactions.description: Preconditions: harness disinfected, umbrella guiding in place, bucket anchor under tree. Action: use the alcohol spray to sanitize the bucket's anchor connection and check that the bucket remains filled/positioned; re-tension or re-seat the anchor if needed so the opened umbrella over the bucket remains a reliable soft catch as the cat descends.
